observations.why: Establishing a recurring cadence for rehearsals appeals to stability/readiness (conservation) and capability through practice (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The aphoristic equivalence frames unrehearsed capability as no capability at all, appealing to mastery-through-practice as the good.
Recording a fixed cadence for rehearsals appeals to stability and ongoing security-readiness.
Assigning ownership for the rehearsal program appeals to accountability as a stability mechanism.

mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression frame practice or rehearsal as the constitutive condition for claiming a capability?
